studies.parent: Latest inductive Ani LDA revision and its ensemble. Original Ani/ensemble retained as additional references.
studies.recipe: Fit a gold-only centered RBF kernel ridge model (gamma.001, alpha.1 or1) to conditional sample-F1 utility of all31 nonempty label sets. Select maximum predicted utility. Matched label-regression control uses the same fitted kernel and ridge but thresholds five regressed binary labels at.5 plus nonempty fallback. Blend the resulting hard expert vote at.25 into the latest Ani LDA source (.75 retained). Native ensemble partners unchanged; no outer labels select weights or regularization.

studies.purpose: Binary and conditional Other heads against the LDA revision.
studies.parent: Latest inductive Ani LDA revision and its ensemble. Original Ani/ensemble retained as additional references.
studies.recipe: Freeze latest LDA source and ensemble. Global binary shrinkage LDA predicts Other from gold only, with empirical or uniform priors; average its probability halfway into source Other decision score. Conditional LDA and C.1 LR fit only gold Recruitment rows; compare empirical and balanced priors. On source-predicted Recruitment only, raise Other to conditional score if larger; empirical models use cutoff.5, balanced models use conservative cutoff.8. First four source scores stay identical. Zero/one-class training fallback is the constant observed label (zero for empty); no pseudo-labels train a head.

studies.purpose: Alternative neighbor geometry against the LDA revision.
studies.parent: Latest inductive Ani LDA revision and its ensemble. Original Ani/ensemble retained as additional references.
studies.recipe: Keep latest LDA architecture, coefficients, C.1, k10, squared-positive-cosine weights, GMM/PCA30 teacher, confidence.8 and cutoff.3. Modify only neighbor coordinates: fitting PCA30, full150 partial whitening (divide by eigenvariance^.25), or omit top1/top3 PCs. All transforms fit outer fitting inputs only. Apply during final neighbor prediction alone or during both pseudo-label teaching and final prediction. LR/LDA always use original standardized embeddings; GMM always uses original PCA30.

studies.purpose: Grouped gold-subset averaging against the LDA revision.
studies.parent: Latest inductive Ani LDA revision and its ensemble. Original Ani/ensemble retained as additional references.
studies.recipe: Within each outer training partition, create five grouped80%-gold subsets using seed270118 and multilabel-stratified embedding groups. Remove excluded gold groups from masked inputs too. Refit the complete native scaler/GMM/pseudo-label/LDA source per subset. Average raw source probabilities before .3 centering, using either pure subset mean or half subset/half full-source mean. Apply to all reasons or Other only. Original ensemble partners and decoder fixed. No outer query participates in any member fit.

studies.purpose: Reference-distance features for remaining reason confusion.
studies.parent: Latest inductive Ani LDA revision and its ensemble. Original Ani/ensemble retained as additional references.
studies.recipe: Freeze LDA source/ensemble. Fit Other specialists only on gold Recruitment rows using seven features: nearest/mean3/mean10 cosine similarities to gold Recruitment-without-Other references; maximum cosine to Other-without-Recruitment references; similarity margin; nearest-minus-mean10; standardized-embedding norm. Training reference distances exclude the entire example embedding group. Query distances use all permitted fitting references. Standardize seven features on specialist training rows only. Compare C1 LR and shrinkage LDA, empirical versus balanced priors. On source-predicted Recruitment only, raise Other using fixed cutoff.5 (empirical) or.8 (balanced). First four source scores stay fixed. No pseudo-labels train references or specialist.

studies.purpose: Joint reason-set LDA and expected sample-F1 decoding.
studies.parent: Latest inductive Ani LDA revision and its ensemble. Original Ani/ensemble retained as additional references.
studies.recipe: Treat each observed gold label set as a distinct multiclass outcome. Fit shrinkage LDA using either gold-only rows or latest revision's augmented targets, with empirical or uniform pattern priors. Decode the joint pattern distribution by exact expected sample-F1 over 31 nonempty sets. On source-predicted Recruitment, add Other with hard score1 only when the joint decoder includes Other. Preserve first four scores and existing Other decisions. Source pseudo-label teaching, ensemble partners and default final decoder unchanged.

studies.purpose: Protein-target and fingerprint retries on the stronger LDA source.
studies.parent: Latest inductive Ani LDA revision and its ensemble. Original Ani/ensemble retained as additional references.
studies.recipe: Freeze latest revision LDA, neighbors and pseudo-labels. Retest protein-target indicators and Morgan fingerprints in the final C.1 logistic head. Compare augmented fitting against half-replacement by gold-only fitting; include no-feature controls for both. The original source logistic weight is .5 and ensemble source weight is .7. Metadata RMS weight.3, same previous parsers and fingerprint settings. Fingerprint columns use union of top60 positive chi-square values per label on fitting gold only; normalization and missingness match the preceding biochemical study.

studies.purpose: Year drift, recency-weighted LR and time-aware neighbors.
studies.parent: Latest inductive Ani LDA revision and its ensemble. Original Ani/ensemble retained as additional references.
studies.recipe: Six fixed temporal variants: remove half of linear embedding drift using all allowed inputs, or within-reason drift using gold only; five/ten-year recency half-life in final C.1 LR while preserving every class weight mass; five-year temporal weighting of cosine neighbors at final prediction only or also during the two pseudo-label rounds. The LDA/neighbor/logistic source weights and original ensemble partners stay fixed. All transforms and teachers are refitted within the outer fitting partition.

studies.purpose: Recent-gold experts and fixed blends with the full-data source.
studies.parent: Latest inductive Ani LDA revision and its ensemble. Original Ani/ensemble retained as additional references.
studies.recipe: Four frozen recent-gold expert blends: five-year width with half probability blend for all queries; five-year half blend only for late queries; five-year quarter blend only late; eight-year half blend only late. Recent means fitting-gold maximum year minus width; extend cutoff to ensure min(3, available positives) per label. Close selected gold over embedding groups, omit excluded gold entirely and purge its groups from original masked rows. Refit scaler, PCA/GMM and complete LDA pseudo-label pipeline on selected gold plus remaining allowed masked inputs. Blend raw source probabilities before centering. Late query gate is year >= fitting-gold maximum minus one; no query-batch fitting. Ensemble partners stay fixed.

studies.purpose: Inner-only cutoff learning, with equal or recent-weighted objectives.
studies.parent: Latest inductive Ani LDA revision and its ensemble. Original Ani/ensemble retained as additional references.
studies.recipe: Keep all three submitted model components unchanged; learn the source centering cutoff from three-fold grouped inner OOF predictions (seed 20261106), refitting the full inductive LDA pseudo-label pipeline and both ensemble partners in each inner fit with inner held-group masked purges. Four recipes: shared cutoff or five label cutoffs, each with equal or five-year-half-life gold recency weighting (floor .1). Maximize inner ensemble sample-F1 minus .01 times squared cutoff displacement/.1 per free parameter. Fixed candidate grid .3,.25,.35,.2,.4; shared one pass, label-specific two ordered coordinate passes. Change only on strict objective improvement, preserving incumbent on ties. Gold targets and all final model fits unchanged. No actual test inputs.

scope: This integration branch's 27 versioned studies and six supporting reviews/export directories. Earlier imported research remains indexed by research/independent/README.md and its immutable import manifest.
interpretation: Registries include controls and related variants. Confirmation is relative to the study's declared parent. Incomplete runs are not completed negative experiments. These results do not establish whether the same changes help the newer anchored classifier.
retention_note: Code, settings, failures and summaries retained. Detailed predictions only for leaders/references. Verification entries are historical, before cleanup.
